contentText:
The robot vacuum also offers up to 30,000Pa of suction, but who cares about that.

At CES 2026, Anker debuted the Eufy S2, a powerful robot vacuum and mop hybrid that cleans your floors while also perfuming your home.

According to the company, the robovac features a built-in "aromatherapy system" with scent options that include bamboo, sage, bergamot, lychee, citrus, and basil. The idea is to perfume your space while the robot cleans, though how noticeable - or welcome - that will be in everyday use remains to be seen.

Aside from trying to make your home smell like a spa, the Eufy S2 also is a powerful cleaning machine - at least on paper. It's rated for up to 30,000Pa of suction, placing it near the top of the category. …

Read the full story at The Verge.
